summary.oneLiner: Lucknow-based IVD company that develops, manufactures and markets diagnostic reagents, kits and POC devices and manufactures/imports/distributes diagnostic instruments B2B to diagnostic labs, hospitals and medical colleges.
summary.business: Q-Line develops, manufactures and markets a diverse range of reagents (kits and POC devices) and consumables, and manufactures/imports/distributes diagnostic equipment, supplying since 2013 - directly or via distributors - mainly to diagnostic service providers, hospitals and medical colleges.
